data.name: Mohammed
data.gender_notes: Mohammed is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The most praised one. The name Mohammed carries the meaning “Praised” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Mohammed usually hope their child will grow to embody praised and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the highest spiritual values and is considered to be the most perfect name for a male child
data.etymology: Mohammed belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praised.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mohammed total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: محمد
in_arabic.meaning: محمد اسم الله تعالی نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم
in_arabic.long_meaning: محمد اسم الله تعالی نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم، مشتق من مادة حمد يدل علي الثناء والحمد لله تعالی، وهو من أسماء الله الحسان التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، ويعني الحمد أو المحمود

in_urdu.name: محمد
in_urdu.meaning: محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کا نام، اللہ تعالی کی تعریف و ثناء
in_urdu.long_meaning: محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کا نام، جو اللہ تعالی کی تعریف و ثناء سے ماخوذ ہے، یہ نام قرآن کریم میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور اہل سنت وجماعت کے نزدیک یہ نام خاص طور پر ہمارے پیارے نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کا نام ہے

in_hindi.name: मोहम्मद
in_hindi.meaning: मोहम्मद, अल्लाह की प्रशंसा और स्तुति
in_hindi.long_meaning: मोहम्मद, जो अल्लाह की प्रशंसा और स्तुति से लिया गया है, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है, और हमारे पैगंबर मोहम्मद सल्लल्लाहु अलैहि वसल्लम का नाम है, जिनका जन्म मक्का में हुआ था

in_pashto.name: محمد
in_pashto.meaning: محمد، د الله تعالی ستاينه او حمد
in_pashto.long_meaning: محمد، د الله تعالی ستاينه او حمد، دا نوم د افغانستان او ټولې نړۍ د مسلمانانو لپاره ډېر مقدس دی، او د اسلام د پېغمبر، حضرت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم نوم دی

in_english.name: Mohammed
in_english.meaning: Praiseworthy, Glorified, One who is highly praised
in_english.long_meaning: Mohammed, derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-m-d' which means 'to praise', is a name that signifies 'the praiseworthy one' or 'the glorified one'. It is a name of high importance in Islam, as it is the name of the Prophet Muhammad, the founder of Islam, who is considered by Muslims to be the last prophet sent by Allah. The name Mohammed is mentioned in the Quran and has been a popular name among Muslims for centuries, symbolizing admiration, respect, and devotion to God.

pronunciation.urdu: اردو میں تلفظ کی تفصیل: محمّد
pronunciation.pashto: په پښتو کې د تلفظ تفصیل: محمد

data.cultural_impact: The name Mohammed is the most- Common name among Muslims around the world. It is regarded with great respect and reverence as the name of the Prophet of Islam, who is regarded as the last messenger of God. The name Mohammed has been a significant cultural force in shaping the Islamic world. It is a source of pride and identity for millions of Muslims, representing their connection to their faith and heritage. In many Muslim communities, the name Mohammed is used not only as a personal name but also as a sign of respect and honor for Prophet Mohammed, often being used as a title or prefix.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, the name Mohammed holds immense spiritual significance as the name of the Prophet who received and delivered the message of God to humanity. According to Islamic belief, Prophet Mohammed was chosen by God to be the last in a long line of prophets, including Adam, Abraham, Moses, and Jesus, among others. His name is a reminder of his unique role in conveying God's message and guiding humanity towards a righteous path. For Muslims, calling upon the name of Prophet Mohammed is a source of comfort, protection, and strength. It is also a reminder of their duty to follow his teachings and live in accordance with the Islamic principles of faith and morality.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Praised" symbolizes The most praised one. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mohammed serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of praised.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Prophet of Islam and founder of the Islamic religion The name Mohammed carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mohammed is considered the last prophet of God in Islam and is the central figure of the religion. He is believed to have received divine revelations from Allah through the angel Gabriel, which were compiled into the holy text of the Quran.
